body: Arrived quickly and well packed. I like that it supports my neck for a whole flight. Used it for 1 week. Firmness is excellent for the price. Recommended seller, fast response too.

name: Rudi U.
title: Love this memory foam travel pillow
body: Mantap! What won me over is that it has a cover that is soft and washes well. The carry bag alone makes it worth buying. Definitely worth the price.

name: Dewi Pratama
title: Nice, but not perfect
body: Bought this on a friend's recommendation and no regrets. In daily use it has a cover that is soft and washes well. Used it for 1 week. The carry bag alone makes it worth buying. The instructions could be clearer, but I figured it out. Good value, I bought a second one for my sister.

name: Dian Nasution
title: Pretty good overall
body: Third purchase from this seller. In daily use it clips onto my luggage easily. Used it for 2 months. The clip alone makes it worth buying. The instructions could be clearer, but I figured it out. Definitely worth the price.

name: Nadia A.
title: Good memory foam travel pillow, minor issues
body: Barang bagus, sesuai deskripsi. Truth is, it clips onto my luggage easily. The clip alone makes it worth buying. The price crept up a little after I bought it, but still fair. Would recommend to anyone looking for one.

name: Wahyu Maulana
title: Very happy with it
body: Impressed so far. Best part: it has a cover that is soft and washes well. Got mine in Grey. Used it for 5 months. I was most impressed by the neck support. Very satisfied overall.
